title: RaceTrace Race Analysis Package
description: One package per race session. Code computes facts, Claude writes prose that cites facts, the validator refuses any package whose prose disagrees with its facts. Definitions of every quantity: stage2/core/DEFINITIONS.md. Design notes: stage2/core/SCHEMA_NOTES.md. Times are seconds (numbers, millisecond precision). Wall-clock times are ISO 8601 with a UTC offset. Race dates are calendar dates. Car identity is always a string ('007' != '7').

schemaVersion.description: Version of this schema. Semver: a major bump breaks readers. 1.1.0 adds raceSummary.keyMoments, carStories[].events and ruleFindings[].severity.

status.description: Lifecycle. Only 'published' packages are served to the site.

completeness.description: Per-section state. A published package must have every section 'complete' (enforced below).

engineVersion.description: Fact-engine version that produced the facts.

rulebookVersion.description: Rulebook file id@version applied, e.g. 'imsa-impc-2026@1.2.0'. null when no rulebook covers the series (D2): facts and stories only, no rule checks.

pitGroups.description: Back-to-back passages that share a lap. Time lost is reported once per group.

IsoDateTime.description: ISO 8601 date-time with an explicit offset (never a naive local time).

CarId.description: Car number exactly as exported. Leading zeros are significant.

ClassId.description: Slug of the class name; must match a metadata.classes[].id.

FactId.description: Stable, human-readable id. Grammar in SCHEMA_NOTES.md §3, e.g. 'car:007', 'lap:007:12', 'pit:007:2', 'pitgroup:11:1', 'fcy:3', 'pen:77:1', 'ret:72', 'flag:4', 'stint:7:2', 'drive:7:1', 'cycle:Silver:1', 'cycres:Silver:1:007', 'pass:24:12:007', 'lapdown:11:21', 'rule:min-pit-lane-time:77:1', 'finding:3', 'story:7', 'summary', 'dq:5'.

Confidence.description: Rules in FACT_ENGINE_SPEC.md §5. high: official data, no ambiguity. medium: derived with a documented approximation. low: inferred; Claude must judge it before a story may state it as fact.

ConfidenceNotes.description: Machine-readable reason codes for a non-high confidence (catalogue in FACT_ENGINE_SPEC.md §5).

kind.description: official: copied from an official timing file. derived: deterministic computation on official data. reconstructed: rebuilt from indirect evidence (e.g. FCY from per-lap flags). inferred: heuristic classification. manual: entered by the owner.

refs.description: Row or record pointers, e.g. 'f1:L119' (1-based line incl. header), 'f2:card:11:1', 'f4:rc:10:37:51.506'.

clock.description: Wall clock, when the source carries a time of day (absent for WRL-website exports).

value.description: The value as stated in the prose. Numbers equal the fact exactly (after transform): seconds at full millisecond precision with no rounding, everything else equal. Text equals the fact verbatim.

field.description: Dotted path inside the fact, e.g. 'timeLost.valueS', 'classPosAfter', 'members.length'. For lap facts it is a laps column name.

display.description: The GUI rendering of value. Required for unit 's': [h:]m:ss.sss to 3 decimals, never rounded, no trailing ' s' (e.g. 1:50.554, 0:47.123, 1:00:34.129; negative values lead with '-'). 'P5' for unit 'pos'; the integer for lap, laps, places, count.

transform.description: Prose may state |x| or -x (e.g. 'lost 6 places' for netClass -6).

Prose.description: Text with placeholders. '{n}' = refs[n]. Entity tokens '{car:007}', '{class:Silver}', '{driver:7:2}' render names. After removing tokens and metadata.lexicon terms, the text may contain no digit; every number is a reference (validator rule V4).

status.description: absent = series not covered by v1 rule checks (D2).

missingFields.description: Rulebook fields still TBD; their checks report 'unknown'.

reportMark.description: Status printed by the timing provider (results files).

medianCleanGreenLapS.description: Median of all clean green laps of the class (D-REF-PACE).

id.description: Canonical track id (one per circuit layout; fixes duplicate names).

pitLaneTransitS.description: Track/rulebook value for a drive-through pit-lane passage; null when not configured (D-TRANSIT).

raceDate.description: Local calendar date of the start (D-DATE). Never a timestamp.

timezone.description: IANA zone of the track, e.g. 'America/Indiana/Indianapolis'.

resultsStatus.description: Status of the results file that finishing positions came from (D-FINISH).

lexicon.description: Proper names that may contain digits and may appear verbatim in prose (series, event, class, team, vehicle, driver names).

postRacePenaltyS.description: Time added after the race, = totalTimeS - elapsed at the last crossing, when that is > 0 (D-PENALTY).

prePenaltyPositionOverall.description: Position the car would hold without its own post-race time penalty (D-FINISH). null when no post-race penalty.

make.description: Normalised make (D-MAKE), e.g. 'BMW', 'Ford', 'Toyota', 'McLaren', 'Mercedes-AMG', 'Honda', 'Hyundai', 'Audi', 'Cupra', 'Porsche', 'Aston Martin'. 'TBD' when no source names it. Drives the Make filter and Make column on every tab.

makeBasis.description: Where make came from (D-MAKE). 'none' when make = 'TBD'.

makeRaw.description: Source value before normalisation, e.g. 'BMW M', 'Toyota Gazoo Racing'.

vehicle.description: Full model string as published, e.g. 'BMW M4 GT4 (G82) EVO'. 'TBD' when no source names it.

result.description: null only when no results file exists (then metadata.resultsStatus = 'none').

LapColumns.description: One car's laps as parallel arrays (all arrays have the same length, ascending lap). Row fact id: 'lap:<car>:<lap>'.

lapTimeS.description: Official lap time; null when blank in the source (never 0.001).

endS.description: raceTimeS of the line crossing that ends the lap.

span.description: Laps covered by the row (>1 when the source skipped lap numbers, WRL-website). Omitted when all 1.

flag.description: Flag at the line as exported (G green, Y yellow/FCY, R red, C chequered, S safety car).

fcyFrac.description: Fraction of the lap interval inside FCY periods (3 dp).

pit.description: Bitmask: 1 in-lap of a passage, 2 out-lap of a passage, 4 lap wholly inside a passage.

pos.description: Overall position at this crossing (lap-chart convention, D-POS).

lapsDown.description: Laps behind the class leader at this crossing (D-LAPDOWN).

clean.description: 1 = clean green lap (eligible for the reference pace, D-REF-PACE).

driver.description: Driver slot number (entries[].drivers[].number); null when unknown.

speedKph.description: Optional. Lap average speed as exported (Alkamel KPH; SH Speed converted, unit TBD). Replaces legacy 'spd'.

columnSources.description: Source and default confidence per column.

exceptions.description: Cells whose confidence differs from the column default.

end.description: Green flag; for a race finishing under caution = the last crossing of the race.

leaderLaps.description: [first, last] overall-leader laps that overlap the period (display band).

pitsOpen.description: Pit-opening announcements during the period (IMSA class-specific).

method.description: D-LOSS-GREEN, D-LOSS-FCY (primary), D-LOSS-FCY fallback, grouped (value lives on the pitGroup), none (retirement, pit-lane start, no reference).

anchorS.description: fcy_neighbours: T0 = end of the lap before the in-lap.

elapsedS.description: fcy_neighbours: T0 to end of out-lap.

greenReferenceValueS.description: For FCY stops: the green-referenced value, kept for audit only. Never displayed as time lost.

ordinal.description: 1-based order of pit-in among all this car's passages (every kind).

kindBasis.description: Evidence used by D-PIT-KIND, in order of precedence.

pitIn.description: null when the source has no pit-lane timestamps (WRL).

inLap.description: D-INLAP: the car's lap that contains pit-in.

inLapCompleted.description: false when the car never completed the in-lap (retired in the pits mid-lap).

outLap.description: D-OUTLAP; null when the car never crossed the line again.

officialPitLaneTimeS.description: D-PITLANE: official pit-in to pit-out. null when no official record (never a lap-time estimate).

groupId.description: pitGroups id when back-to-back with another passage.

stopNumber.description: Ordinal among this car's kind 'stop'/'garage' passages (the 'Stop N' label). null for other kinds.

penaltiesServed.description: Penalties served by or during this passage (DT, S&G, time-at-stop).

lapDown.description: Car lost a lap to its class leader across this passage (D-LAPDOWN).

positionEffect.description: Class position across this passage alone (D-CYCLE-POS applied with the passage as its own window). Present for rejoined passages that are not cycle members (drive-throughs, garage visits, penalty stops); members use cycleResults.

reason.description: Infringement as written, e.g. 'Pit Lane Speed Violation'.

resultsEffectS.description: Time difference actually visible in the results file (may differ from amountS; see dataQuality).

driveTimeS.description: D-DRIVETIME: stint duration minus pit-lane time of penalty passages inside it.

officialDriveTimeS.description: Drive Time CSV TOTAL DRIVER TIME when available.

opens.description: Earliest member pit-in (WRL: start of earliest in-lap).

closes.description: Latest member rejoin (pit-out; WRL: end of out-lap).

gapThresholdS.description: rounds: 4 x class median clean green lap.

windowS.description: windows: 3 x class median clean green lap.

maxGapS.description: Largest gap between consecutive member pit-ins.

nearestSplitMarginPct.description: How close the nearest gap came to the threshold; < 5 % lowers confidence.

overlappingPassageIds.description: Same-class non-member passages (drive-throughs, garage, retirements) between opens and closes. Context only.

passId.description: The last swap between the two inside the window.

afterLap.description: null when the car never completed a lap after the cycle closed (retired).

timeLostRank.description: 1 = least time lost among members with a value.

PositionChangeTable.description: Every same-class order swap between consecutive lap-chart laps (D-SWAP). Row fact id: 'pass:<winner>:<lap>:<loser>'. Lapped events: 'lapdown:<car>:<lap>'.

mechanism.description: Neutral mechanism; per-perspective cause mapping in DEFINITIONS.md D-CAUSE.

fcy.description: 1 when either car's lap L overlaps an FCY period.

lapDowns.description: Events where a car's laps-behind-class-leader increased (D-LAPDOWN).

section.description: Regulation article cited by the rulebook field, e.g. 'IMSA SR 46.3.1'.

status.description: unknown = rulebook value TBD or input fact low confidence.

margin.description: measured - limit, signed so negative = violation.

officialAction.description: Penalties race control issued for the same subject.

statement.description: Prose shown by the GUI as the finding wording.

judgementOnLowConfidence.description: Required by the validator when any cited fact is low confidence.

severity.description: Rulebook severity vocabulary (rules/RULEBOOK_FORMAT.md R7). The GUI shows it; no other vocabulary is used.

lap.description: Lap the moment happens on (unit 'lap'); the GUI shows it as 'L16'.

lapEnd.description: Last lap when the moment spans laps (e.g. an FCY period).

causes.description: GUI cause chips (GUI_SYSTEM_SPEC.md §6.1). Empty for a result moment.

StoryEvent.description: Timeline card. The fact engine builds every field except title and text (buildStoryEvents); Claude fills title and text as Prose. A published story's skeleton must equal the engine's.

lap.description: First lap of the event (in-lap for a pit passage).

lapEnd.description: Last lap when the event spans laps.

at.description: When the event starts (raceTimeS, and the wall clock where the source has one).
